tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently visited a popular tourist destination called 'Sunny Beach Resort.' While the experience was partially enjoyable, you noticed that some aspects of the resort are environmentally harmful. You want to suggest some improvements to the resort manager, Mr. Collins. Write an email to Mr. Collins.
bullets: Describe what you enjoyed about your stay at the resort.
Explain your concerns about the resort's environmental impact.
Suggest some measures that could be implemented to make the resort more environmentally friendly.
tasks.subject: Suggestions for eco-friendly practices at the resort
